workflowName: Weekly Editors Health Check: constrained HTTP availability

evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

definition.workflowName: Weekly Editors Health Check: constrained HTTP availability

intent.goal: Monitor documented workflow editor health and keep preview screenshots up to date.
intent.acceptance: Constrained facet only: independently attributable original HTTP GET responses return exactly 200 for each actual standalone documented editor destination at a checkpoint.

evaluation.reason: Reachability pre-existed adoption. No original historical HTTP responses are retained in the permitted offline sources; reconstruction remains open, not proven impossible.
evaluation.classificationReviewRequired: Review if independently attributable pre-adoption original responses become available.

frozenSource.scopeDecision: Three actual standalone editor destinations; ancillary WebAssembly prose link excluded. This is not literal Step-0 coverage or full-goal acceptance.
frozenSource.historicalSourceLimitation: Adoption source requires LinkButton-only discovery; current source also accepts Markdown/bullets. Ancillary-link exclusion is a constrained facet, not retrospective full-goal acceptance. Compiled bodies were pending at initial freeze and are retained in subsequent source closure.

evidence.opportunity: One original HTTP GET per actual documented editor destination in one complete checkpoint.
filters: Sequential heading-bound standalone URL, LinkButton or standalone Markdown destination.
Exclude screenshot image destinations and ancillary prose documentation references; preserve their original responses separately.
Match checkpoint inventory revision, exact resolved URL and editor ID; do not follow redirects.
Accept independently attributable original HTTP responses or original curl connection failures with separate immutable independently verified probe-environment evidence.
Missing instrumentation, unreliable probes and an empty editor population are unavailable, never 100 percent.
evidence.collection: Offline batch replay of digest-checked immutable source profiles and preserved original HTTP checkpoints; no API or current probes during evaluation.
evidence.checkpointRule: Checkpoint completedAt equals the explicit snapshot windowEnd; no last-known-value carry or current-state backdating.
evidence.sourceRetention: Git preserves inventories, not HTTP availability. Issue/PR identities and screenshots cannot reconstruct response status.
evidence.matching: Exactly one independently validated receipt per inventory editor; retain ancillary and duplicate responses outside the measured facet.

model.architecture: Source-derived deterministic reachability facet with explicit missing instrumentation.
model.recommendation: Report native availability without inferring editor functionality, screenshot freshness or workflow contribution.

metrics.name: Available documented editors
metrics.formula: 100 * independently verified HTTP-200 editor responses / all eligible actual editor destinations at the same complete checkpoint

retained: HTTP 200 availability as an explicitly constrained independent repository-outcome facet.
gates: Complete immutable editor population and independently attributable original per-editor responses.

metricReview.architecture: Source-derived deterministic reachability facet with explicit missing instrumentation.
metricReview.recommendation: Report native availability without inferring editor functionality, screenshot freshness or workflow contribution.

metrics.name: Available documented editors
metrics.formula: 100 * independently verified HTTP-200 editor responses / all eligible actual editor destinations at the same complete checkpoint
